theorems.name: FB_CODE_CORRESPONDENCE
theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> lw_reference_code image

theorems.name: FB_EMPTY_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q 0 false

theorems.name: FB_EQUAL_MISALIGNED_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word 2097153)
        (word 2097217)
        17
        false /\
        (forall i.
             i < 17
             ==> lw_memory image (word 2097153) (word 2097217) 17 false
                 (word_add (word 2097153) (word i)) =
                 word 128 /\
                 lw_memory image (word 2097153) (word 2097217) 17 false
                 (word_add (word 2097217) (word i)) =
                 word 128)

theorems.name: FB_FULL_IMAGE_EXISTS
theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding.
    fb_file_code file_bytes
    ==> (exists image.
             fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image /\
             lw_reference_code image)

theorems.name: FB_IMAGE_PRESERVATION
theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q n different.
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image /\ lw_layout p q n
    ==> fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding
        (lw_memory image p q n different)

theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word (2 EXP 47 - 1))
        (word 2097153)
        1
        false

theorems.name: FB_MACHINE_WITNESS_EXISTS
theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding.
    fb_file_code file_bytes
    ==> (exists image.
             fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image /\
             (forall p q.
                  fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q 0 false) /\
             fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word 2097153)
             (word 2097217)
             17
             false /\
             fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word 2097153)
             (word 2097217)
             17
             true /\
             fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word 2097155)
             (word 2097155)
             33
             false /\
             fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word 2097153)
             (word 2097154)
             17
             false /\
             fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word 2097159)
             (word 2097287)
             16
             false /\
             fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word (2 EXP 47 - 1))
             (word 2097153)
             1
             false /\
             fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word (2 EXP 64 - 1))
             (word 2097153)
             1
             false /\
             fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word 2101247)
             (word 2162691)
             17
             false)

theorems.name: FB_PRE_LIFT

    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image /\
    lw_layout p q n /\
    lw_pre image p q n different
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q n different

theorems.name: FB_UNEQUAL_FAMILY
theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding image.
    fb_file_code file_bytes /\
    fb_full_image file_bytes initial_rw padding image
    ==> fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image (word 2097153)
        (word 2097217)
        17
        true /\
        lw_memory image (word 2097153) (word 2097217) 17 true (word 2097153) =
        word 128 /\
        lw_memory image (word 2097153) (word 2097217) 17 true (word 2097217) =
        word 255

theorems.name: FB_VALID_ABI
theorems.statement:
fb_abi_initial_fields fb_initial_abi /\
assurance_canonical48 (val (read ABI_FS_BASE fb_initial_abi)) /\
fb_tls_page (val (read ABI_FS_BASE fb_initial_abi))

theorems.name: FB_PRE_FILE_CODE
theorems.statement:
forall file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q n different.
    fb_pre file_bytes initial_rw padding image p q n different
    ==> fb_file_code file_bytes
